verdicts.evidence: All three paragraphs are set in a heavy, connected, slanted brush script, and 'twelve minutes', 'lower deck' and 'before dusk' are all in that text.

The bold sans title is larger, but the three heavy, dense script paragraphs below it carry more ink and texture, so the claim that they compete for attention is a judgment about elements that are there.
A neutral bold sans heading sits above brush-script body text, so the two different voices the finding describes are visible.
The paragraphs say 'every forty minutes between early morning and late evening', 'a little longer when the tide turns' and 'leaves the quay before dusk', and nowhere give a clock time.
